title: Canonical affine scalar/tensor comparison and its composition law
statement: For affine coordinates and a commuting square as in [def-pc-affine-coordinate-comparison-data], define the module comparison as the mate of the global-sections/pushforward comparison, using tilde adjunction, coordinate pushforward equivalence [lem-pc-affine-coordinate-module-models], scalar extension/restriction adjunction, and the fixed tensor/pushforward adjunctions [lem-pc-perfect-hom-cochain-counit]. For composable commuting squares, these comparisons compose with exactly ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp and the fixed underived tensor-pullback composition mate. Termwise lifting and passage to homotopy preserve the same composition identity. The acyclic module model conventions are those of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model].

proof.text: Construct coordinate global sections and its right-adjoint square comparison by pushforward composition and pushforwardSpecMapCompΓIso. On a global section each factor is the identity; therefore the right-adjoint comparisons compose.

Take the adjunction mates of these canonical comparisons. Apply the adjunction-square pasting theorem; the scalar composition map is exactly the mate of restrictScalarsComp and the tensor map is exactly the fixed mate of pushforwardComp. Evaluate at each module to get the module-level equation.

Factor termwise application through the composite chart functor, so degreewise components reduce to the module comparison without unfolding the full mate construction. Apply the module equation degreewise, then map it through the homotopy quotient. The mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso factors identify the resulting tensor comparison with the fixed one.

lean.statement: theorem affineCoordinateHomotopyComparison_comp (a b c : AffineComparisonCoordinate.{u, w}) (φ : a.A →+* b.A) (ψ : b.A →+* c.A) (p : b.X ⟶ a.X) (q : c.X ⟶ b.X) (hp : b.σ.hom ≫ p = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ a.σ.hom) (hq : c.σ.hom ≫ q = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ b.σ.hom) (hs : c.σ.hom ≫ (q ≫ p) = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ψ.comp φ)) ≫ a.σ.hom) (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} a.A) ℤ) : (perfectHomTensorHomotopy q).mapIso ((affineCoordinateHomotopyComparison a b φ p hp).app M) ≪≫ (affineCoordinateHomotopyComparison b c ψ q hq).app (((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M) = (perfectHomTensorHomotopyComp q p).app ((affineCoordinateHomotopy a).obj M) ≪≫ (affineCoordinateHomotopyComparison a c (ψ.comp φ) (q ≫ p) hs).app M ≪≫ (affineCoordinateHomotopy c).mapIso ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp φ ψ) (.up ℤ)).app M)
